_doc: The builds a new game offers (scripts/archetypes.gd, shown by the title screen's New game). skills: a value for every skill of data/skills.json, from min to max; every build spends the same points (min x six skills + points), and the check refuses one that does not. Custom lets the player spend the points freely. Nothing here says who the player is: the story keeps that open.

archetypes.name: Ledger
archetypes.description: You trust what can be counted. Spears, boots, days to the thaw: a number stays where you put it. People rarely do.

archetypes.name: Upright
archetypes.description: You keep your back straight and your voice level. Most orders carry themselves out if they are given as though they already had been.

archetypes.name: Listener
archetypes.description: You hear the room before it speaks. Cooks, sergeants, old stone: all of them say more than they mean, if you wait out the weather.

archetypes.name: Level
archetypes.description: Nothing in you sticks out and nothing gives way. A little of every voice, and none of them sure to win the argument.

custom.name: Custom
custom.description: Twelve points and six voices. Nobody will ask for your reasons.
